in_sanskrit.name: इतिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Itika is derived from the Sanskrit root 'it' which means 'desire' or 'wish', and the suffix 'ka' which means 'thinking' or 'imagination'. It signifies one who has strong desires and imaginations.

in_hindi.name: इतिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: Itika is also used in Hindi and it means 'the focus on desire'. It can be used to encourage someone to focus on their desires and work towards achieving them.

in_tamil.name: இதிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, Itika means 'one who is deeply engrossed in desire'. It can be used to describe someone who is passionate about their desires and focuses all their energy towards fulfilling them.

in_telugu.name: ఇదికా
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, Itika means 'one who is deeply engrossed in desire'. It can be used to describe someone who is passionate about their desires and focuses all their energy towards fulfilling them.

in_marathi.name: Itika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Itika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Itika is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'itih' which means 'that which is'. It is a name given to a girl, signifying divinity, purity, and the essence of the universe. The name is rich in spiritual meaning, symbolizing wisdom, self-realization, and inner peace.
